segments.name: Commercial
segments.description: Commercial property and casualty insurance serving commercial customers and business enterprises.
segments.evidence: Our commercial property and casualty insurance operations are managed and reported in three business segments: Specialty, Commercial and International, which we refer to collectively as Property & Casualty Operations.

segments.name: International

segments.evidence: Our commercial property and casualty insurance operations are managed and reported in three business segments: Specialty, Commercial and International, which we refer to collectively as Property & Casualty Operations.

segments.name: Corporate & Other

revenueModel.text: Insurance customers pay premiums for commercial property and casualty coverages, surety, life and group insurance, warranty and risk management services.
